snippet.title: Triumvora - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Triumvora is an Indie Action RPG with Survival, Roguelite and Hack 'n Slash elements, in a surreal world of plants and concrete.

Eat, gather, befriend and kill your way to the top, in a race against your own species. Prove your versatility as a pack leader, and become the unchallenged Ruler of the urban jungle. 

Wishlist "Triumvora" on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3549120/Triumvora/

#triumvora
